name: model_interventions (Bloom syndrome, Blm mice)
built_by: hand-curated in step 11, experiment T1 (entry 156) by entry 150's method, from PubMed abstracts; PMID, title, year and journal from NCBI eutils esummary on 2026-09-25
method: Every published intervention (genetic or pharmacological) found in Blm-deficient mouse models, plus one context row (BLM overexpression). Search: eutils esearch on PubMed, two queries fixed before reading any title - Q1 (Bloom syndrome / Blm-deficient / Blm mutant / Blm-null / Blm hypomorphic ... AND mice AND rescue / ameliorate / treated with / treatment / inhibitor / suppress, NOT bleomycin; 133 hits) and Q2 (the same model words plus 'BLM helicase' AND mice AND rapamycin / metformin / antioxidant / N-acetylcysteine / PARP / olaparib / growth hormone / insulin / nicotinamide / resveratrol / senolytic / dasatinib / quercetin / vitamin / drug / pharmacolog*, NOT bleomycin; 38 hits, 10 not in Q1) - plus the 7 PMIDs MGI attaches to the 13 Blm genotypes the twin scored. 147 unique records screened by title (133 + 10 + 4 genotype PMIDs not already hit) (most Q1 hits are bleomycin lung-fibrosis models or the BLM melanoma cell line, both 'BLM' abbreviations); 6 abstracts read with efetch (29620483, 25908507, 26443207, 42156715, 12242442, 24858046). 26443207 (Nsmce2), 24858046 (Mus81) and 12242442 (Blm heterozygotes) are genetic-interaction or model papers with no intervention and are not rows. twin_rank_* are NA: no row's paper is linked to a genotype MGI_PhenoGenoMP scores.
result: no Blm-model intervention names an approved drug that supports a direction: the G2 rule lists 0 drugs for this case. The one approved analogue named (olaparib, for the PARP-inhibitor class) is on a 'warns' row.

sources.clinical: child_hpo_link (column name kept for the table contract) names Bloom syndrome's own HPO terms (OMIM:210900, phenotype.hpoa 2026-09-02) each rescued phenotype corresponds to
sources.genomic: none directly; the gene (BLM) comes from the case file

inputs.name: PubMed esearch/esummary/efetch
inputs.licence: NCBI public; abstracts remain the publishers' copyright (quoted in paraphrase)

inputs.name: ressources/track2/transfer-it4/BLM/phenotype/phenotype_twin_genotypes.tsv
inputs.role: the Blm genotypes scored and their MGI PMIDs

search_log: build/it4/track2-t1/g2_q1.json, g2_q2.json (esearch replies), g2_q1_summary.json, g2_q2_summary.json (esummary), g2_abstracts.txt (efetch)
assumptions: a cellular rescue in a Blm-deficient background is evidence for the mechanism only; no organism-level rescue was found
limitations: abstract-level only; the 'Blm' abbreviation collides with bleomycin and a melanoma cell line, so recall depends on the NOT bleomycin clause and title screening; full texts not read
